CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Chair Petersen, Shaffer, Chooljian,

item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency

CITIZEN APPLICATIONS

1.  PC-332-11; Application to remove 1 Brazilian pepper tree located in the city
  parkway adjacent to 2205 Chelsea Road

  Applicant:  Marczella Nagelvoort
  2205 Chelsea Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to remove 1 Brazilian pepper
tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2205 Chelsea Road according to the

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 27, 2011.
 ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. One 24-inch box Australian
Willow (Geijera parviflora) replacement tree is required.

2.  PC-333-11; Application to remove 1 Aleppo pine tree located in the city parkway
  adjacent to 416 Via Almar

  Applicant:  Greg Baetge
  416 Via Almar
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to restructure 1 Aleppo pine tree
located in the parkway adjacent to 416 Via Almar by removing one of the co-
dominate trunks.

3.  PC-334-11; Application to remove 1 Italian stone pine tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 1433 Via Zumaya

  Applicant:  Roberta Mitzenmacher
  1432 ViaZumaya
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to remove 1 Italian stone pine
tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1433 Via Zumaya according to the
‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. One 24-inch box Little Gem
Magnolia (Magnolia grandiflora ‘Little Gem’) replacement tree is required.

OLD BUSINESS

4.  PC-328-11; Los Angeles Regional Park and Open Space District Grant

Action: Approved (5-0). Staff is directed to complete the application and budget
monies for:
  • Donation to the ‘Tree Bank’  $38,000
  • Installation of Pergola lights  $ 5,000
  • Refurbishment to Via Victoria Path  $30,000
  • Trail re-establishment in Malaga Cove  $68,000
  • Installation of George Allan Field Bleachers $10,000
  $150,000

NEW BUSINESS

None

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 27, 2011.
 ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

5.  Letters to the Parklands Committee from residents residing on Paseo Del Campo
  concerning the triangular center median at the intersection of Paseo Del Campo
  and Via Campesina

Form a sub-committee of Parklands Committee member Schoenheider, the City
Forester, and neighborhood residents adjacent to the triangular median at Via
Campesina and Paseo Del Campo, to conceptually design, scope and estimate
landscape improvements to the median.

6.  Letter to the Parklands Committee from Joseph J. Ryan Jr. concerning

Resolved through Code Enforcement.

Action: Approved (5-0).

The Parklands Committee is a adjourned to October 10, 2011.
